cards.ex: That cat video became an instant internet sensation.
cards.exUz: O'sha mushuk videosi bir zumda internet yulduziga aylandi.
cards.uzDef: Internetda tezda mashhur bo'lib ketgan odam yoki narsa.

cards.ex: Kids these days are digital natives; they understand tech intuitively.
cards.exUz: Hozirgi bolalar raqamli avlod, ular texnologiyalarni tabiiy ravishda tushunishadi.
cards.uzDef: Texnologiyalar bilan tug'ilgan va ularni yaxshi biladigan odam.

cards.ex: We need to get this campaign trending on Twitter.
cards.exUz: Biz bu kampaniyani Twitterda trendga chiqarishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Bir narsani internetda ommabop qilib, ko'p muhokama qilinishiga erishish.

cards.ex: People are braver behind the screen; they say things they wouldn't face-to-face.
cards.exUz: Odamlar ekran ortida jasurroq bo'lishadi, ular yuzma-yuz aytmaydigan narsalarni gapirishadi.
cards.uzDef: Internetda yashirincha, o'zini ko'rsatmasdan harakat qilmoq.

cards.ex: Social media allows everyone to voice their opinion.
cards.exUz: Ijtimoiy media har kimga o'z fikrini bildirishga imkon beradi.
cards.uzDef: O'z fikrini, qarashini internetda ochiq aytish.

cards.ex: Her online persona is very different from how she is in real life.
cards.exUz: Uning onlayn qiyofasi hayotda qandayligidan juda farq qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Odamning internetdagi yaratgan va namoyish etadigan shaxsiyati.

cards.ex: I need a digital detox; I'm spending too much time online.
cards.exUz: Menga raqamli detoks kerak, men juda ko'p vaqtimni onlayn o'tkazyapman.
cards.uzDef: Vaqtincha internet va texnologiyalardan voz kechish.

cards.ex: Cybersecurity threats are a major concern for businesses.
cards.exUz: Kiberxavfsizlik tahdidlari biznes uchun asosiy tashvishdir.
cards.uzDef: Internet orqali kompyuter tizimlariga qilinadigan xavfli hujumlar.

cards.ex: It's important to be able to identify fake news online.
cards.exUz: Internetda soxta yangiliklarni aniqlay olish muhim.
cards.uzDef: To'qilgan, yolg'on ma'lumotlar tarqatish.

cards.ex: I went down the rabbit hole researching conspiracy theories last night.
cards.exUz: Men kecha kechqurun fitna nazariyalari haqida ma'lumot izlash uchun chuqurga tushib ketdim.
cards.uzDef: Bir narsa haqida ko'p vaqt sarflab, batafsil ma'lumot izlash.

cards.ex: The internet offers a wealth of information on almost any topic.
cards.exUz: Internet deyarli har qanday mavzu bo'yicha ma'lumot boyligini taklif qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Juda ko'p va qimmatli ma'lumotlar to'plami.

cards.ex: My friend got hacked and lost all his photos.
cards.exUz: Do'stimning akkauntiga xakerlik hujumi bo'ldi va u barcha rasmlarini yo'qotdi.
cards.uzDef: Xakerlar tomonidan tizimga kirish va ma'lumotlarni o'g'irlash.

cards.ex: Online harassment is a serious problem that needs to be addressed.
cards.exUz: Onlayn ta'qib jiddiy muammo bo'lib, unga e'tibor qaratish kerak.
cards.uzDef: Internetda odamlarni bezovta qilish, qo'rqitish yoki haqoratlash.

cards.ex: Don't be such a couch potato; go outside and get some exercise.
cards.exUz: Bunday dangasa bo'lma, tashqariga chiq va mashq qil.
cards.uzDef: Televizor yoki internet oldida ko'p vaqt o'tkazadigan odam.

cards.ex: We're always plugged in these days; it's hard to disconnect.
cards.exUz: Biz hozirgi kunda doimo ulanib turamiz, aloqani uzish qiyin.
cards.uzDef: Texnologiyalarga bog'langan, doimiy ravishda internetda bo'lish.

cards.ex: It's hard to keep up with all the new social media platforms.
cards.exUz: Barcha yangi ijtimoiy media platformalariga qo'shilib borish qiyin.
cards.uzDef: So'nggi yangiliklar va tendensiyalardan xabardor bo'lish.

cards.ex: My social media feed is a curated feed of things I enjoy.
cards.exUz: Mening ijtimoiy media lentam menga yoqadigan narsalardan iborat saralangan lenta.
cards.uzDef: Faqat o'zingizga yoqadigan va qiziqarli ma'lumotlardan iborat lenta.

cards.ex: I'm so addicted to my phone; I can't put it down.
cards.exUz: Men telefonimga shunchalik mukkasidan ketganmanki, uni qo'yolmayman.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaga haddan tashqari bog'lanib qolish.

cards.ex: The rumor spread like wildfire on social media.
cards.exUz: Mish-mish ijtimoiy tarmoqlarda yong'indek tarqaldi.
cards.uzDef: Tez va keng miqyosda tarqalmoq (ko'pincha ma'lumot).

cards.ex: You have to take everything you read online with a grain of salt.
cards.exUz: Internetda o'qigan hamma narsaga shubha bilan qarashingiz kerak.
cards.term: Take with a grain of salt
cards.uzDef: Biror ma'lumotga to'liq ishonmaslik, shubha bilan qarash.

cards.ex: Technology changes so quickly; things become obsolete in a matter of years.
cards.exUz: Texnologiya shunchalik tez o'zgaradiki, narsalar bir necha yil ichida eskirib qoladi.
cards.uzDef: Keraksiz bo'lib qolmoq, ishlatilmaydigan bo'lib qolmoq.

cards.ex: Social media encourages surface-level interactions.
cards.exUz: Ijtimoiy media yuzaki munosabatlarni rag'batlantiradi.
cards.uzDef: Chuqur emas, faqat tashqi ko'rinishdagi.

cards.ex: He posted a 'missed connection' ad hoping to find the girl he saw on the train.
cards.exUz: U poyezdda ko'rgan qizni topish umidida 'o'tkazib yuborilgan aloqa' e'lonini joylashtirdi.
cards.uzDef: Internet orqali topishga urinilgan, avval uchrashilgan, lekin aloqa yo'qolgan odam.

cards.ex: Companies are very concerned about their online reputation.
cards.exUz: Kompaniyalar o'zlarining onlayn obro'lari haqida juda tashvishlanadilar.
cards.uzDef: Odamning internetdagi fikri va bahosi, odamlar uning haqida o'ylaydigan fikr.

cards.ex: Data mining is used to understand consumer behavior.
cards.exUz: Ma'lumot qazish iste'molchilarning xatti-harakatlarini tushunish uchun ishlatiladi.
cards.uzDef: Katta hajmdagi ma'lumotlardan foydali ma'lumotlarni topish jarayoni.

cards.ex: Social media can create an echo chamber where you only hear opinions you agree with.
cards.exUz: Ijtimoiy media siz rozi bo'lgan fikrlarni eshitadigan aks sado xonasini yaratishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Faqat o'z fikrlariga o'xshash fikrlarni eshitadigan muhit.

cards.ex: I use ad blockers to filter out annoying ads online.
cards.exUz: Men onlayn bezovta qiluvchi reklamalarni filtrlash uchun reklama blokerlaridan foydalanaman.
cards.uzDef: Keraksiz yoki yoqimsiz narsalarni olib tashlash.

cards.ex: I'm going dark for a week to focus on my studies.
cards.exUz: Men o'qishlarimga e'tibor qaratish uchun bir hafta davomida qorong'ilikka kiraman.
cards.uzDef: Internetdan vaqtincha uzilish, hech qanday onlayn faoliyat qilmaslik.

cards.ex: Meme culture is a huge part of online humor.
cards.exUz: Mem madaniyati onlayn hazilning katta qismidir.
cards.uzDef: Internet memlarining ommaviy madaniyatda tarqalishi va ahamiyati.

cards.ex: If you don't update your skills, you'll quickly fall behind the curve.
cards.exUz: Agar siz o'z mahoratingizni yangilamasangiz, tezda orqada qolasiz.
cards.uzDef: So'nggi tendensiyalardan xabardor bo'lmaslik, orqada qolish.
